messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

What is the best technique for turning an abstract specification into executable code — such that the result actually holds its commitments?

Stay within this direction: training neural models on execution-trace traces with runtime invariant monitors

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Neural models trained on execution-trace data that includes runtime invariant violations as negative examples will generate code satisfying formal postconditions more reliably than models trained on traces containing only successful executions, because the invariant-violation examples teach the model to avoid the specific state transitions that break commitments. Under this approach, the optimal training distribution contains at least a 1:3 ratio of violating-to-successful traces, indexed by the specific invariant class that was violated; any model trained below this ratio will fail to reliably produce code that holds its commitments on held-out specifications."}
